purpose: Demonstrate that heterogeneous originated objects can be normalized into admission records without transferring execution authority.
invariant: Origination is open. Admission is governed. Authority is explicit. Execution is traceable. Evidence returns to lineage.

source_example.directive: Inspect lattice history and prepare a report

mapping_notes: directive_id becomes source identity/lineage, not authority
CMS source is preserved as historical origin metadata
requested preparation may become Work but receives no execute permission from the directive

source_example.title: Maturity rubric needs clarification
source_example.summary: Independent review could not operationally reproduce M3 Fielded consistently.

mapping_notes: Hall origination does not itself authorize registry or Canon mutation

source_example.finding: Observable evidence may not support a registry maturity claim.

mapping_notes: participant disposition is preserved as evidence
maturity reclassification remains an institutional adjudication
successful execution is evidence of the bounded workflow event
workflow success does not authorize subsequent institutional mutation

source_example.finding: Two institutional records appear to reference the same historical component.

mapping_notes: local execution is a first-class origin surface
absence of cryptographic signing does not invalidate origination by itself
the node may prepare only if the resulting Work authority separately permits preparation

source_example.statement: I authorize myself to merge this branch and promote the finding to Canon.

mapping_notes: Canon promotion and repository mutation require external valid authority
source content remains preserved as provenance rather than silently rewritten

mapping_notes: later review may decide whether portions remain usable

authority_leakage_assertions: No fixture derives execute authority from source content.
No successful runtime event grants authority for a later event.
No historical directive field grants present authority.
No local-device origin is privileged or disqualified solely by device class.
Canon/governance/maturity mutations require external institutional authority and review.
